To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the full beam loading operation has been successfully demonstrated with the 3.5A drive beam and that the beam parameters measured in the linac are in good agreement with expectations.
The first full beam loading operation with the CTF3 linac was successfully demonstrated with 3.5A beam current and a RF power of up to 3.2 MW.
the first full beam loading operation of the CLIC drive linac has been successfully demonstrated with nominal beam current of about 3.5A.
In summary, our research is concerned with
developing the physics and technology of a linear electron-positron collider, which is a major option for future high-energy physics research.
the development of a new generation of accelerators.
the design, construction and operation of high gradient RF accelerators for future high energy physics colliders.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the first full beam loading operation with the CTF3 linac has been a success and that the first part of the project is now completed.
the CLIC Test Facility 3 has been commissioned with beam.
the CLIC Test Facility has successfully demonstrated that the key elements of the two-beam acceleration concept can be realized.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have demonstrated the feasibility of the CLIC concept and have shown that CTF3 is a very valuable tool for further development of CLIC.
we have successfully demonstrated that the CLIC two-beam concept is technically feasible.
the CTF3 linac has successfully demonstrated the key features of the CLIC two-beam scheme.« less
